parts.label: CHASSIS
parts.note: rigid body, with the stationary cassette insert
parts.desc: the rigid plastic body and casing of the radio cassette recorder, with its speaker grilles, printed scales and the stationary cassette window

parts.label: CASSETTE DOOR
parts.desc: the hinged cassette door on the front of the tape deck, a sprung lid that swings open to eject the cassette

parts.label: KEYS
parts.desc: the six piano keys of the tape transport, the play, record, pause, cue, review and stop eject buttons pressed by a finger

parts.label: KNOBS
parts.note: four rotary joints: volume, balance, tone, tuning
parts.desc: the four rotary knobs and dials on the top deck, turned for volume, balance, tone and radio tuning

parts.label: FUNCTION SELECTOR
parts.desc: the sliding function switch, a slider selecting tape, AM or FM

parts.label: CARRY HANDLE
parts.desc: the folding carry handle, a bar on two pivots across the top of the radio

channels.label: SEGMENT
channels.note: the part each cell was plotted in

channels.label: CELL AREA
channels.note: plot density — where the budget was spent
